en: I'm glad to see you dressed to the nines for this.
Don't think it changes anything, however. I can't let you do it.
And here comes my beloved husband, trying his best to save his own skin once again.
I'm sorry, my love, but I can't let you reignite the beacon. I'll stop you even if it means killing my husband and king.
You again... so stubborn.
En garde!
Here comes the interloper. After all the Malaise has done to the kingdom, you should realize that we cannot allow anything to leave the island. But I guess you're beyond reasoning now.
I'm sorry, but I have to stop this folly right here, right now. Know that I won't take any pleasure in killing you.
I wish things had turned out otherwise. Cursed be the Malaise!
I guess... the die is cast then...
Enjoy your meal.
With the compliments of the chef.
I wouldn't eat that if I were you...
It's rude to eat while in combat.
This one is a little bit too rich.
Staggering!
I am used to turning heads.
See the world in a new perspective.
I reign supreme here. I even control the way you see my domain.
Enjoy the view.
Buying is cheating.
This is the price you have to pay for standing against me.
Did this old man really try to sell you items he found in MY Castle?!
Keep your gold.
Thank you, I didn't know he was hiding there.
Dodge these.
Enough playing around, die now.
Burn!
You'll never reach my throne.
I'll destroy you.
All my bat familiars were so eager to meet you!
Devour them!
Go on, my little friends, exsanguinate them.
I love bats, don't you?
Humanity will learn to fear my bats. Let's start with you.
Will you be able to tell fact from fiction?
You're surrounded.
Your eyes betray you.
Reality obeys me.
Trust no one... even yourself.
Disappointing.
You simply weren't up to the task.
You were the last, yet fragile, if I may, rampart of this world.
I win, you lose, everything is as it should be.
It's hard to find good antagonists, nowadays...
Let's raise the stakes.
This one looked a bit puny, I'm only giving it a fighting chance.
Pick on someone your own size... or slightly bigger.
I don't follow the rules, I only play to win.
You were doing too well, I had to intervene and keep this interesting.
This creature cannot be transformed!
No new blueprints to be drawn from this creature.
Borrow ::amountGet:: {iconCoin@img}
Error, you can't borrow more gold in this life.
Thank you for your patronage! Please come again!
Ka-ching! Here's your money.
... a loan is a binding commitment that engages your very soul and ...
Thanks! Have you considered borrowing more?
No bank teller this time.
Security doesn't seem to be their strong suit.
Let's take the key, I guess.
This door will open at the end of the ongoing votes.
Go back to the start of the floor
Kill nearby enemies first!
What a strange idea, building a monument underground...
An artifact, an artifact-shaped hole and a door... Not very subtle.
"Please DO NOT break that door!"
Hey! You there! Hit me!
I've been VERY naughty.
Hit me HARD!
I'm a naughty treasure chest that deserves to be punished...
Hmmm... I have so much to offer you...
I'm a very secretive little treasure chest, you know.
Don't you want to see what I have in store for you?
Come on... Surely I deserve a little spank...
HIT ME, DAMMIT!
Hmmm... me-owwwww!
Grrrrr... come on, scratch me again!
Ouch, that's gonna leave a mark... good for me.
Cursed Chest found!
That doesn't seem to work.
You have visited this next biome far less than the other currently available biomes.
Visiting it will provide a bonus to cell and gold drop rates.
This biome is cursed!
Cursed monsters will appear in it. Beware of their special attacks!
Not enough gold!
Hey!
What the?!
Hey!!
There's got to be a way to open this barrier somewhere...
I don't need it.
This strange book tells the tale of heroes from other worlds. Some of its cryptic sentences seem to be providing clues... but for what?
I already know how all these stories end. Stupid book!
This page is titled "Blasphemous". " 'Cause this flask in your head is bad for your health".
Okay, I guess.
This one is called "Hyper Light Drifter". It tells the tale of a man in a Drifter outfit and his reliable sword.
Clear as day.
The subject here is "Hollow Knight". "How much can you bounce?".
Bounce? But how?!
"Guacamelee". A story about the savior of the "Mexiverse" that fought countless undead wrestlers bare-handed (and footed).
I'm always up for a good fight!
Curse of the Dead Gods. It says that a seasoned explorer knows not to get hit by those nasty traps ONCE.
Who could have thought...
